name: Jinan Yaoqiang International Airport
before:
Shandong's provincial capital airport, about 33 km north east of Jinan, and twenty fifth busiest in China with 20,329,972 passengers in 2025. It runs roughly 150 routes to more than 90 cities and averages 1,100 flights a day.

Line 3 of the Jinan Metro serves the airport, and by road it connects to the Jinan Ring, the Beijing to Shanghai and the Qingdao to Yinchuan expressways.

Long haul has come and gone. Sichuan Airlines opened a non-stop service to Los Angeles in December 2016, and Condor flew to Frankfurt from February 2022 until January 2023, when it moved the route to Hefei. Check what is actually flying before assuming a direct European link.

The terminal covers 114,000 square metres with 24 air bridges and is rated for 12 million passengers a year, a figure the airport has comfortably passed.

It opened on 26 July 1992, replacing Jinan Zhangzhuang, with the current terminal following in March 2005.
after:
Shandong's provincial capital airport, about 33 km north east of Jinan, and twenty fifth busiest in China with 20,329,972 passengers in 2025.

Line 3 of the Jinan Metro serves the airport.

Condor flew to Frankfurt from February 2022 but dropped the route in 2023. Check what is actually flying before assuming a direct European link.

claims.note: Was 'until January 2023, when it moved the route to Hefei'. The sources disagree on the detail: Wikipedia says Condor stopped in January 2023 and started flying to Hefei; AeroRoutes (21 March 2023) says Condor's summer 2023 flights to Hefei and Jinan were both replaced by Hangzhou from 1 May 2023. Both put the end in 2023, so only the year is given.

sources.quote: in January 2023, Condor ceased the service again

quote: The new service to Hangzhou will be replacing previously filed 1 weekly flight each to Hefei and Jinan.

claims.wasBefore: It runs roughly 150 routes to more than 90 cities
claims.why: Route counts need a source from the last 12 months. Besides Wikipedia, the only count found is the 21st Century Business Herald's of October 2024 ('more than 150 routes to more than 90 cities'); the airport's own site (jnairport.com) answered 503 and 405, and the Jinan government article Wikipedia cites for this now redirects to the site's home page.

quote: 济南机场通达国内外90余个城市，开通150余条航线

claims.why: Contradicted by CAAC's 2025 table: 145,034 aircraft movements in the year, which is about 400 take-offs and landings a day, not 1,100 flights. Wikipedia is the only source for 1,100.

claims.wasBefore: and by road it connects to the Jinan Ring, the Beijing to Shanghai and the Qingdao to Yinchuan expressways
claims.why: Wikipedia alone; no second source found.

claims.claim: long haul has come and gone
claims.wasBefore: Long haul has come and gone.
claims.why: Contradicted. The Jinan government reports Hainan Airlines flights from Jinan to Paris via Chongqing, twice a week, from 11 March 2026 (held back below, one source), and the 21st Century Business Herald (October 2024) reports Jinan's first direct Sydney route from November 2023.

sources.quote: A new intercontinental flight connecting Jinan, Chongqing, and Paris was inaugurated on March 11, expanding Shandong province's air link with Europe.
继去年11月首次开通赴澳大利亚悉尼的直飞航线后

claims.claim: Sichuan Airlines to Los Angeles from December 2016
claims.wasBefore: Sichuan Airlines opened a non-stop service to Los Angeles in December 2016
claims.why: Wikipedia alone. Its source, Routes (routesonline.com), answered with a Cloudflare block page ('Sorry, you have been blocked'), so it was not tried again by any route. No current source says whether the flight still runs.

claims.claim: Condor stopped in January 2023 and moved the route to Hefei
claims.wasBefore: until January 2023, when it moved the route to Hefei
claims.why: Sources disagree: AeroRoutes (21 March 2023) has Condor replacing its filed Hefei and Jinan flights with Hangzhou from 1 May 2023. Softened to 'dropped the route in 2023'.

claims.claim: terminal of 114,000 square metres, 24 air bridges, 12 million capacity, comfortably passed
claims.wasBefore: The terminal covers 114,000 square metres with 24 air bridges and is rated for 12 million passengers a year, a figure the airport has comfortably passed.
claims.why: The area and the 12 million capacity rest on Wikipedia's reading of the airport's 2017 website; the airport's site did not answer. Travel China Guide (August 2025) gives about 11 hectares and 24 boarding bridges but no capacity. The building is now called Terminal 1, and a second terminal is being built in the airport's second phase (iQilu, November 2024), so a description of 'the terminal' will date; no source from the last 12 months says whether Terminal 2 has opened.

claims.claim: replacing Jinan Zhangzhuang; current terminal March 2005
claims.wasBefore: It opened on 26 July 1992, replacing Jinan Zhangzhuang, with the current terminal following in March 2005.
claims.why: The exact opening day, Zhangzhuang and the March 2005 terminal rest on Wikipedia alone. The year of opening is kept (Travel China Guide).

claims.claim: Hainan Airlines Jinan to Paris via Chongqing, twice weekly, from 11 March 2026

quote: A new intercontinental flight connecting Jinan, Chongqing, and Paris was inaugurated on March 11, expanding Shandong province's air link with Europe.
Operated by Hainan Airlines using Boeing 787-9 aircraft, the service offers twice-weekly flights with 291 seats.

claims.why: Held back: one source only. It would replace 'Long haul has come and gone' and matters to a UK agent (a one-stop service to Europe), but no second publisher could be read: Hainan Airlines' Chinese site answered 502, the Chongqing government's English site 502, the Shandong government's English site did not connect, and neither Air Journal nor AeroRoutes (Hainan Airlines listings) carries the Jinan service. The Jinan English site is produced by China Daily, so a China Daily copy would not count as a second organisation. Was to read: "Hainan Airlines has flown twice a week to Paris, stopping in Chongqing, since March 2026."

claims.claim: a second terminal is being built

sources.org: iQilu (Shandong Radio and Television news site)
sources.quote: 机场北站位于济南机场二期改扩建工程综合交通中心下方，待机场二期改扩建工程完成后，可实现与T2航站楼一体化换乘

claims.why: Held back: a new terminal replaces nothing in the old text, and the only source is from November 2024 (the metro's Airport North station will serve Terminal 2 when the airport's second phase is finished). Whether Terminal 2 has opened needs a source from the last 12 months; none could be read.

Cut in review (23 Sep evening). The helper kept the year with Travel China Guide as the only second source; the brief allows travel guides only as a tie-breaker, never as the second source. The day and month rest on Wikipedia alone.

sources.quote: was completed and opened to traffic on 26 July 1992

opinion.text: Check what is actually flying before assuming a direct European link.
opinion.why: The old text's advice, kept: the only European service found (Hainan Airlines to Paris, from March 2026) stops in Chongqing and rests on one source, so checking is still the right advice.
